about_item: Helps Stop Fast Eating & Supports Healthy Digestion - Designed for dogs that eat too quickly. Spread wet or dry foods from peanut butter and yogurt to meats, fish, fruits, or veggies, across the textured surfaces to slow feeding, reduce gulping, and support better digestion.
Calms Dogs During Grooming, Bath Time & Vet Visits - Use as a soothing distraction during stressful moments like nail trimming, bathing, or vet exams to help reduce anxiety and keep your dog relaxed.

Keeps Dogs Busy & Reduces Boredom - The varying difficulty of the mixed groove depths provides long-lasting licking activity that promotes calm behavior and mental stimulation for medium to large dog breeds of all ages.

Strong Suction Cups Stick to Floors, Walls & Tubs - Designed with non-slip suction cups to stay securely in place on tile, hardwood, glass, or bathtub surfaces. Great for both horizontal and vertical use.

Safe, Durable & Easy to Clean - Made from food-grade, BPA-free, PVC-free, phthalate-free, and plastic-free silicone that’s safe for daily use. Top-rack dishwasher safe for quick cleanup, plus freezer and microwave safe.

summary.text: Customers find the lick mat to be of good quality and effective for cleaning, with one mentioning their dog spends 30 minutes using it while eating. Moreover, the product receives positive feedback for its stimulation value, with one customer noting it keeps their bigger dog occupied long enough for nail trimming. Additionally, customers appreciate the suction cups that help keep the mat in place. However, the depth of the grooves receives mixed reviews, with one customer finding them too shallow.
